scope: isolated local SQLite; shipped activation SQL; no production records touched
checks: Only the approved flag changes; draft/public differences, custom settings, prior snapshots and revision history are preserved
Repeated activation is idempotent and never overrides a later CMS disable action
Missing, unpublished and archived settings are not published, recreated or activated
An already enabled site receives the one-time marker without unnecessary content revisions
Concurrent transactions produce one activation, one revision increment and one pair of original snapshots
